svg.title: The seven steps of one service invoking a method on another through their Dapr sidecars
svg.desc: Four shapes in a row: a green hexagon named App A, a hexagon carrying the Dapr logo, a second such hexagon, and a blue hexagon named Service B. The request runs left to right along the top, numbered one from App A to its sidecar, three from that sidecar to App B's sidecar under the words Invoke method, and four on to App B. The response runs back along the bottom, numbered five, six and seven. Between the two sidecar legs is a padlock in a shield labelled mTLS. A line numbered two rises from App A's sidecar to a box named Name resolution component, and another rises from App B's sidecar to a heart-pulse mark named Observability backend. Under each service and its sidecar is the call it carries: POST over the path /v1.0/invoke/checkout/method/order on the left, and POST /order on the right.
